title: Decorrelated telemetry federation and pager attenuation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: On-call noise and false-positive burn-rate pages are increasing as we onboard more model-serving variants and region routing. Current SLO alerts rely on coarse metric aggregates and a single burn-rate threshold which causes correlated alerts across services during regional infra churning and batch-processing spikes. We need a telemetry federation layer that decorrelates trace-driven signals from noisy metric spikes, surfaces the right anomaly surface for each SLO, and attenuates paging for low-confidence burn-rate events.
goals: Build a telemetry federation service that merges traces, metrics, and logs into a per-SLO signal with decorrelation heuristics
Add a burn-rate simulation harness that replays historical incidents to validate alert precision/recall
Implement a pager attenuation matrix (policy engine) to suppress pages for low-confidence or noisy signals while still creating tickets/notifications for review
Expose dashboard panels showing signal provenance (trace spans -> metric buckets -> alert decision) for each affected SLO
out_of_scope: Full rewrite of backend ingestion pipeline (we will add sidecars/adaptors)
acceptance_criteria: Federation service merges trace attributes and metric histograms for 90% of incoming SLO-relevant requests in canary region
Burn-rate simulation reproduces 3 historical incidents with >=70% fidelity and shows reduced false pages in simulation
Pager attenuation rules prevent pages for at least 60% of prior low-confidence burn-rate events while creating internal tickets for all suppressed events
New dashboard widgets available in Console that annotate alerts with top-3 contributing traces and histogram deltas
implementation_notes: We will implement a lightweight sidecar (Go) that subscribes to the Kafka telemetry topic and enriches metric events with span fingerprints from the trace index. A small stateful service will maintain a sliding-window histogram per SLO and compute an adjusted burn-rate using a decorrelation factor derived from trace-uniqueness heuristics. Attenuation policies are policy-rules (yaml) evaluated in the routing layer; allowlisting for high-severity customers will bypass attenuation. Initial canary will be us-east-1 and the experiments tracked in an internal dashboard.
tradeoffs_and_decisions: Decision: Use sidecars + federator service rather than modifying ingest pipeline to minimize blast radius
Trade-off: Slightly higher end-to-end processing latency (25-50ms) vs much improved alert precision — acceptable for SLO alerting tier
Decision: Policy rules as yaml checked into repo to allow rapid tweaks by SREs without new deploys
Trade-off: Avoid deep ML anomaly model in first phase to keep predictability; plan ML-backed scoring in phase 2
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sidecar overhead increases CPU on serving nodes; Mitigation: cap sampling rate and enable adaptive sampling based on traffic percentile
Risk: Missed high-severity incidents due to attenuation; Mitigation: policy thresholds include an override for absolute-error and customer-impact flags
Risk: Data mismatch between traces and metrics; Mitigation: add a reconciliation job that flags >5% mapping failures and fails open for paging
testing_plan: Unit tests for decorrelation heuristics and histogram math
Integration test: synthetic replay from prod-like trace+metric dump
Chaos test: induce region transient in staging to verify attenuation reduces page storm
E2E: Canary in us-east-1 for 48 hours with parallel baseline alerting enabled for metric-only alerts
deployment_plan: Phase 0: Deploy sidecar + federator in staging, run replay tests
Phase 1: Canary in us-east-1 with attenuation off (observe signals) for 24h
Phase 2: Enable attenuation (conservative rules) in canary for 48h
Phase 3: Gradual rollout to other regions with monitoring and rollback hooks
metrics_to_track: False-positive rate measured vs annotated incidents in burn-rate sim
Mapping success rate (trace -> metric) per minute
notes: Design review requested w/ SRE and Product. UX will add an 'Alert Provenance' flyout in Console. PM asked for a small admin UI to edit attenuation policies in later cycles.
